description: Science article — all major claims are verifiable and expected to be TRUE.
input_text: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope, launched on December 25, 2021, has captured images of galaxies formed just 300 million years after the Big Bang. The telescope cost approximately $10 billion to develop over a period of more than two decades. It operates at a temperature of –233 °C, shielded by a five-layer sunshield the size of a tennis court. The Webb telescope orbits the Sun at the second Lagrange point (L2), approximately 1.5 million kilometres from Earth.
